commandsAndQueries.method: Executed Python 3 urllib.request HTTPS GET with User-Agent gidps-source-evidence/1.0, 25-second timeout and SHA-256 over response bytes; HTTP JSON endpoints used Accept: application/json and the official news URL used Accept: text/html.
commandsAndQueries.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request, json, hashlib, datetime
urls = {
  'lunaris-version':'https://api.lunaris.moe/data/version.json',
  'genshin-db-head':'https://api.github.com/repos/theBowja/genshin-db/commits/HEAD',
  'genshin-db-latest-release':'https://api.github.com/repos/theBowja/genshin-db/releases/latest',
  'official-german-news':'https://genshin.hoyoverse.com/de/news'
}
for key,url in urls.items():
  observed=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat().replace('+00:00','Z')
  try:
    req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'gidps-source-evidence/1.0','Accept':'application/json' if key!='official-german-news' else 'text/html'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=25) as response:
      body=response.read()
      out={'id':key,'url':url,'observedAtUtc':observed,'httpStatus':response.status,'bytes':len(body),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(),'lastModified':response.headers.get('Last-Modified'),'etag':response.headers.get('ETag')}
      if key=='lunaris-version':
        data=json.loads(body)
        out['topLevelKeys']=list(data) if isinstance(data,dict) else None
        out['latest']=data.get('version') or data.get('latest')
        out['versionStrings']=[x if isinstance(x,str) else x.get('version') for x in data.get('versions',[])] if isinstance(data,dict) else None
        out['providerTimestamp']=data.get('timestamp')
      elif key=='genshin-db-head':
        data=json.loads(body)
        out['headSha']=data.get('sha')
        out['commitDate']=data.get('commit',{}).get('committer',{}).get('date')
      elif key=='genshin-db-latest-release':
        data=json.loads(body)
        out['tagName']=data.get('tag_name')
        out['publishedAt']=data.get('published_at')
        out['htmlUrl']=data.get('html_url')
      print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False))
  except Exception as exc:
    print(json.dumps({'id':key,'url':url,'observedAtUtc':observed,'error':str(exc)},ensure_ascii=False))
PY
